reason: My register has never crashed, never needed recharging and never charged me ₹999 a month. I count the drawer myself every night, so I don't need an app to tell me what should be in it. And putting all my customers on phones my staff carry around feels risky.
objection: If the phone breaks or a stylist leaves with it, where does my customer list go? And if I stop paying the ₹999, do I lose everything I put in?
would_change_my_mind: A free month where I keep my register going too, plus a printed or downloadable copy of all my customers and bills that I can keep even if I stop paying, and no ₹4,999 setup fee.
